brief:
Civil organizations across 19 cities worldwide are preparing coordinated street protests for next Wednesday, according to Shehab Wire. The demonstrations coincide with the International Day of Humanitarian Action and seek to pressure governments and international bodies to lift restrictions blocking the delivery of humanitarian assistance into Gaza.

The organizers plan to mount simultaneous actions across multiple continents to amplify calls for expanded aid access. The timing with the global humanitarian day underscores their focus on the urgency of relief operations in the besieged territory. Participants aim to draw international attention to what they describe as severe constraints on food, medicine, and other essential supplies reaching civilians.
